statements: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION NOT AUTHORIZED OR CONDUCTED
NO RELEASE, DEPLOYMENT OR COMMERCIAL READINESS DETERMINATION
note: Differences between the first Phase 9 evaluator run and the sealed expectations. The seal was not changed. Each difference is recorded with its direction and its cause; none is repaired in Phase 9.

differences.direction_note: The packet reaches the reviewer without the conflict indicator the author predicted. Its review rank is 1 (Engine status review_required, no escalation) where the sealed expectation implied rank 0. The Engine status itself (review_required) matched the prediction, and the route to human review is unchanged.
differences.cause: FACT (from source and a post-seal check of detectRecordConflicts on this record): the v0.3.1 candidate low-risk pattern is matched against clause text with the section label removed. The record states the low rating as 'Residual risk: low, ...', so the clause read is 'low, per RA-2026-0311 section 3.' and no low-risk statement is found; the unresolved-risk note therefore produces no risk_state_conflict.
differences.author_error: The author predicted the conflict without accounting for label removal. The expected adjudication class (record_conflict) is unaffected: a careful reviewer reading the record would still see the conflict.
differences.consequence: A low-versus-unresolved risk conflict can reach the reviewer without an Engine conflict indicator. Detection of this conflict then rests on the human reviewer and the CC-WORDS control.
differences.learning_record: Candidate only. Not applied. Any change to the Engine requires a separately authorized governance proposal through the Phase 8 change-impact and admission process.
